summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges click spans; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style to keep meta; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new and appended tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and tests/test_tabs.py. The layout resolver Edge protocol already had size, min_size, and fraction, so it was left unchanged. Tests have not been run; checks were by reading code and rich 11.2 source.
